# 🎬 Miniature Disaster — Higgsfield Style

**Reverse-engineered from @wonderfulworldai tutorial**

Источник: Higgsfield AI + Seedance 2.0

**Ключевые находки:**
- Камера СВЕРХУ ВНИЗ (high angle)
- Человек ОЧЕНЬ близко к камере (cropped by frame)
- Вода с эффектом миниатюры (small droplets, tight foam)
- Handheld shake, natural light
- NO: centered, symmetrical, static camera

data.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 handheld phone video, 15 seconds, one unbroken take, no cuts.

Close, high angle, looking down onto a miniature {{ city }}. Pale sand beach with tiny palm trees on the left, turquoise water on the right. Detailed scale model with white Mediterranean buildings, terracotta roofs, tiny boats in a harbor, cypress trees.

At the very bottom of the frame: the back of a man's head and shoulders in a black "EFFECTS CREW" t-shirt, cropped by the frame edge, very close to the lens. A black camera crane arm hangs into the upper left corner of the frame. Blue chroma key screen with pink/orange tracking markers visible in the far background.

The water is initially CALM and still. Then suddenly a {{ disaster }} begins forming — the water starts rising dramatically. Miniature-scale water physics: small fast droplets, tight foam, visible surface tension.

The wave grows massive and crashes into the miniature city. Spectacular destruction: tiny buildings collapse, water explodes through streets, boats are tossed, palm trees bend and snap. The camera follows the action with natural handheld movement.

All voices off-screen, no speaking face, no lip-sync. Live production sound, large room reverb, no music. Handheld shake throughout, natural bright studio light, no color grade.
